notes: Standard mode spell book: combat fields from presets/legacy/spells.json; id and label from other/spell_map.csv (commercial-safe). Schema: id, element, mana, range, powerCurve, basePower, damageAmplitude (strikes; omit=0), cooldowns (auto/primary/secondary/spell/item), moveLock. Amplitudes via npm run populate:spell-amplitude (ref skill 50).
